Analyze and resolve BIOS/UEFI defects, including system hangs, boot failures, and system stability problems.

Participate in code reviews and provide technical mentorship to junior engineers.
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
5+ years of experience in BIOS/UEFI firmware development.
Strong proficiency in C language programming.

description.text:
【Job Summary】
As a Senior BIOS Engineer at Jabil, Inc., you will be responsible for the design, development, and debugging of UEFI BIOS firmware for various computing platforms. You will play a critical role in bringing up new hardware, and ensuring the stability and reliability of our server products.
【Job Responsibilities】
• Design, develop, and debug UEFI BIOS firmware for server systems.
• Collaborate with hardware design teams during board bring-up and validation phases.
• Analyze and resolve BIOS/UEFI defects, including system hangs, boot failures, and system stability problems.
• Document BIOS architecture, design specifications, and test procedures.
• Stay current with industry trends and emerging technologies in BIOS/UEFI development.
• Participate in code reviews and provide technical mentorship to junior engineers.
【Job Qualifications】
• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
• 5+ years of experience in BIOS/UEFI firmware development.
• Strong proficiency in C language programming.
• In-depth understanding of PC architecture, including Intel/AMD chipsets, processors, and peripheral interfaces (PCIe, USB, SATA, SPI, I2C, etc.).
• Extensive experience with UEFI architecture, TianoCore EDKII, and various BIOS development tools.
• Experience with debugging tools such as ITP, JTAG, and in-circuit emulators.
• Familiarity with hardware schematics and data sheets.
• Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.
• Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively in a team environment.
